description: This file defines module declarations for stream consumer functions in Node.js, providing type annotations for utility functions that process streams, such as arrayBuffer, blob, buffer, json, and text.
external_methods: import { Blob as NodeBlob, NonSharedBuffer } from "node:buffer"

methods.name: function arrayBuffer(stream: WebReadableStream | NodeJS.ReadableStream | AsyncIterable<any>)/ arrayBuffer
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills with an ArrayBuffer containing the full contents of the stream.

methods.name: blob
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills with a Blob containing the full contents of the stream.

methods.name: buffer
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills with a NonSharedBuffer containing the full contents of the stream.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills with the parsed JSON content of the stream as UTF-8 string.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills with the stream content as a UTF-8 string.
